views.name: classroom_core
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  building,
  room_number,
  capacity
FROM classroom
views.description: One row per classroom with its identifying location and capacity. Useful as the canonical cohort of classrooms to filter by capacity or to join to sections.

views.name: section_room_mapping
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  section.course_id AS course_id,
  section.sec_id AS sec_id,
  section.semester AS semester,
  section.year AS year,
  section.building AS building,
  section.room_number AS room_number,
  section.time_slot_id AS time_slot_id
FROM section
views.description: Mapping of course sections to the classroom where they meet (denormalized section -> classroom identifiers and scheduling slot). Useful for queries that need classrooms used by sections or to combine section metadata with room capacity.

views.name: classroom_capacity_summary
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  classroom.building AS building,
  classroom.room_number AS room_number,
  classroom.capacity AS capacity
FROM classroom
views.description: Prepares capacity-related measures per classroom (keeps raw capacity and can compute flags or buckets). Useful for filtering by capacity thresholds or aggregating classrooms by capacity ranges.

views.name: classroom_rows
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  building,
  room_number,
  capacity
FROM classroom
views.description: One row per classroom as recorded in the classroom table. Exposes the classroom's building, room identifier and capacity so downstream queries can filter, group or count classrooms by building or other attributes.

views.name: building_classroom_counts_by_room
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  building,
  COUNT(*) AS classroom_count
FROM classroom
GROUP BY building
views.description: Pre-aggregated counts of classroom rows per building. Keeps one row per building with the raw count of classrooms; useful for queries that need classroom counts per building (filters and ordering applied at query time).

views.name: classroom_capacity_by_building_and_room
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  classroom.building AS building,
  classroom.room_number AS room_number,
  classroom.capacity AS capacity
FROM classroom
views.description: Normalized classroom rows with canonical column names and numeric capacity included. Useful when queries need to consider capacity, filter or aggregate capacities per building, or count classrooms while optionally using capacity as a measure.

views.name: department_core
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  dept_name,
  building,
  budget
FROM department
views.description: Canonical department-level relation exposing department identifier, building, and raw budget for comparisons and joins.

views.name: department_budget_summary
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  COUNT(dept_name) AS dept_count,
  SUM(budget) AS total_budget,
  AVG(budget) AS avg_budget,
  MIN(budget) AS min_budget,
  MAX(budget) AS max_budget
FROM department
grain: global (single row aggregate across all departments)
views.description: Aggregated budget statistics for departments (useful for comparisons to average/median budgets); retains count and aggregate measures at the whole-department level.

views.name: department_with_courses_count
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  d.dept_name AS dept_name,
  d.building AS building,
  d.budget AS budget,
  COUNT(c.course_id) AS course_count
FROM department d
LEFT JOIN course c
  ON c.dept_name = d.dept_name
GROUP BY
  d.dept_name,
  d.building,
  d.budget
views.description: Departments joined to their courses with a per-department count of offered courses and the department budget/building; useful for analyses combining budget and teaching load.

views.name: department_base
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  department.dept_name AS dept_name,
  department.building AS building,
  department.budget AS budget
FROM department
views.description: Canonical department rows with core attributes normalized and exposed for filtering and joins.

views.name: instructors_by_department
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  instructor.ID AS "ID AS instructor_ID",
  instructor.name AS "name AS instructor_name",
  instructor.dept_name,
  instructor.salary AS "salary AS instructor_salary"
FROM instructor
views.description: Instructor rows augmented with their department key and salary; suitable for per-department top-N or analytics.

views.name: department_name_length
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  d.dept_name AS dept_name,
  LENGTH(d.dept_name) AS name_length,
  CASE
    WHEN LENGTH(d.dept_name) >= 15 THEN 'long'
    ELSE 'short'
  END AS name_length_category
FROM department AS d
grain: dept_name  -- one row per department name
views.description: Department name length and a reusable categorical label for long vs short names.

views.name: classroom_by_building
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  building,
  COUNT(*) AS classroom_count,
  AVG(capacity) AS avg_classroom_capacity,
  MIN(capacity) AS min_classroom_capacity,
  MAX(capacity) AS max_classroom_capacity
FROM classroom
GROUP BY building
views.description: Per-building aggregation of classroom properties (one row per building) exposing counts and raw/aggregated classroom capacity measures for use in building-level filters and joins.

views.name: departments_with_building_budget
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  department.dept_name AS dept_name,
  department.building AS building,
  department.budget AS budget
FROM department
views.description: Department rows with their building and raw budget exposed. Useful for aggregating department budgets per building or filtering departments by building.

views.name: dept_budget_by_building
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  building,
  COUNT(dept_name) AS dept_count,
  AVG(budget) AS dept_avg_budget,
  MIN(budget) AS dept_min_budget,
  MAX(budget) AS dept_max_budget,
  SUM(budget) AS dept_sum_budget
FROM department
GROUP BY building
views.description: Per-building aggregation of department budgets: exposes aggregated budget measures per building to join with building-level classroom aggregates.

views.name: classroom_core_15
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  building,
  room_number,
  capacity
FROM classroom
views.description: One row per classroom with its identifying building and room_number plus capacity. Basic cleaned projection of the classroom table for filtering and joins.

views.name: section_room_assignment
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  s.course_id,
  s.sec_id,
  s.semester,
  s.year,
  s.building,
  s.room_number,
  s.time_slot_id
FROM section AS s
views.description: Denormalized mapping of sections to the classroom they are scheduled in (building, room_number) together with section identifiers and time slot, useful to relate scheduled uses of rooms to classroom attributes.

views.name: classroom_capacity_buckets
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  c.building,
  c.room_number,
  c.capacity,
  CASE
    WHEN c.capacity IS NULL THEN NULL
    WHEN c.capacity <= 20 THEN 'small'
    WHEN c.capacity <= 50 THEN 'medium'
    ELSE 'large'
  END AS capacity_bucket
FROM classroom_core c
views.description: Normalized classroom rows with capacity and a derived capacity_bucket to support common range filters (e.g., small/medium/large) without embedding specific numeric literals in views.

views.name: department_core_18
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  dept_name,
  building,
  budget
FROM
  department
views.description: Canonicalized department rows with primary identifying columns and common attributes (one row per department).

views.name: departments_with_classroom_counts
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  d.dept_name AS dept_name,
  d.building AS building,
  d.budget AS budget,
  COALESCE(bcc.classroom_count, 0) AS classroom_count
FROM department AS d
LEFT JOIN building_classroom_counts_by_room AS bcc
  ON d.building = bcc.building
grain: dept_name  -- one row per department (building aggregated classroom_count)
views.description: Departments joined with classrooms in the same building and a count of those classrooms; exposes dept metadata plus building-level classroom metrics for filtering, grouping or sorting.

views.name: department_course_summary
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  d.dept_name AS dept_name,
  d.building AS building,
  COUNT(c.course_id) AS course_count,
  COALESCE(SUM(c.credits), 0) AS total_credits,
  CASE WHEN COUNT(c.course_id) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE AVG(c.credits) END AS avg_credits
FROM
  department d
LEFT JOIN
  course c
ON
  c.dept_name = d.dept_name
GROUP BY
  d.dept_name,
  d.building
views.description: Per-department summary of courses: number of courses and total/average credits; useful for queries combining department metadata and course-level aggregates.

views.name: department_basic
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  dept_name,
  building,
  budget
FROM department
views.description: One row per department with its primary attributes (canonicalized), exposing name, building location and numeric budget for use in filtering, grouping and aggregation.

views.name: department_budget_rank
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  d.dept_name,
  d.building,
  d.budget,
  (SELECT 1 + COUNT(DISTINCT d2.budget) FROM department d2 WHERE d2.budget > d.budget) AS budget_rank,
  (SELECT MAX(budget) FROM department) AS max_budget
FROM department d
grain: dept_name  -- one row per department with rank and global max
views.description: Department rows augmented with the budget ranking (ties allowed) and the maximum budget value so consumers can select top-N or all-tied-top departments without re-aggregating the base table.

views.name: department_budget_cohort
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  COUNT(dept_name) AS dept_count,
  MIN(budget) AS min_budget,
  MAX(budget) AS max_budget,
  AVG(budget) AS avg_budget,
  SUM(budget) AS sum_budget
FROM department
grain: singleton row representing global aggregates over department budgets
views.description: Pre-aggregated measure view that computes aggregate budget statistics (min, max, avg, sum, count) across all departments to support threshold and comparative queries.

views.name: department_buildings
views.body_sql:
SELECT dept_name, building
FROM department
views.description: One row per department-building association: which building is listed for each department.

views.name: classroom_by_building_25
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  c.building,
  c.room_number,
  c.capacity,
  AVG(c.capacity) OVER (PARTITION BY c.building) AS building_capacity_avg,
  COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY c.building) AS building_capacity_count,
  SUM(c.capacity) OVER (PARTITION BY c.building) AS building_capacity_sum
FROM classroom_core AS c
views.description: All classrooms with their capacity, at the classroom-row grain and aggregated summaries per building (exposes raw capacity and building-level aggregates). Useful for computing average/total/counts of classrooms per building.

views.name: department_building_classroom_join
views.body_sql:
SELECT d.dept_name AS dept_name,
       d.building AS building,
       c.room_number AS room_number,
       c.capacity AS capacity
FROM department d
JOIN classroom c ON d.building = c.building
views.description: Denormalized relation joining departments to classrooms by building, exposing department, building and the classroom rows in that building. Keeps classroom rows only when a matching department.building exists.

views.name: students_core
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  student.ID AS ID,
  student.name AS name,
  student.dept_name AS dept_name,
  student.tot_cred AS tot_cred
FROM student
views.description: One row per student with core identifying and academic attributes (demographic/cohort info). Useful as the base cohort for filtering by department, advisor lookups, enrollments, etc.

views.name: department_summary
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  department.dept_name AS dept_name,
  department.building AS building,
  department.budget AS budget
FROM department
views.description: Department-level summary metrics (one row per department). Exposes budget and counts/aggregates that are commonly used to filter or join when answering administrative or analytic questions.

views.name: students_with_department
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  student.ID AS "student.ID",
  student.name AS "student.name",
  student.dept_name AS "student.dept_name",
  student.tot_cred AS "student.tot_cred",
  department.dept_name IS NOT NULL,  -- ensure department joinable (keeps semantics explicit)
  department.building AS "department.building",
  department.budget AS "department.budget"
FROM student
LEFT JOIN department ON student.dept_name = department.dept_name
views.description: Denormalized relation joining students to their department info. Useful for queries that need student attributes together with department metadata (building, budget) for filtering or display.

views.name: classroom_row
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  classroom.building AS building,
  classroom.room_number AS room_number,
  classroom.capacity AS capacity
FROM classroom
views.description: One row per classroom with its identifying keys and capacity. Basic cohort of classrooms for further filtering, grouping or joins.

views.name: classroom_size_category_candidates
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  c.building,
  c.room_number,
  c.capacity,
  CASE
    WHEN c.capacity IS NULL THEN NULL
    WHEN c.capacity <= 20 THEN 'SMALL'
    WHEN c.capacity <= 50 THEN 'MEDIUM'
    WHEN c.capacity <= 100 THEN 'LARGE'
    ELSE 'XLARGE'
  END AS size_category
FROM classroom_core c
views.description: Normalize classroom capacity and assign a reusable size_category label based on capacity ranges. Keep original keys and numeric capacity for alternate thresholds.

views.name: classroom_size_counts_by_category
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  c.building AS building,
  c.size_category AS size_category,
  COUNT(*) AS count
FROM
  classroom_size_category_candidates c
GROUP BY
  c.building,
  c.size_category
views.description: Aggregated counts of classrooms per size_category within any provided cohort (groupable by building or globally). This view expects a pre-classified classroom input (e.g., from classroom_size_category_candidates) and aggregates counts by category and optionally by building.

views.name: advisor_relationships
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  advisor.s_ID AS s_ID,
  advisor.i_ID AS i_ID
FROM advisor
WHERE advisor.i_ID IS NOT NULL
grain: advisor.s_ID, advisor.i_ID  -- one row per advisor assignment
views.description: Row-level advisor relationships linking students to their advisor instructor IDs. One row per advisor assignment.

views.name: instructor_basic
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  instructor.ID AS ID,
  instructor.name AS name,
  instructor.dept_name AS dept_name,
  instructor.salary AS salary
FROM instructor
views.description: Canonical instructor records with key identifiers and numeric salary exposed for filtering and joins.

views.name: advisor_with_instructor
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  advisor.s_ID AS s_ID,
  advisor.i_ID AS i_ID,
  instructor.name AS instructor_name,
  instructor.dept_name AS instructor_dept,
  instructor.salary AS instructor_salary
FROM advisor
JOIN instructor ON advisor.i_ID = instructor.ID
WHERE advisor.i_ID IS NOT NULL
grain: advisor.s_ID, advisor.i_ID  -- one row per advisor assignment enriched with instructor attributes
views.description: Denormalized advisor assignments joined to the corresponding instructor row so advisor IDs and instructor attributes (including salary) are available in one relation.

views.name: students_with_advisors
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  advisor.s_ID AS s_ID,
  student.ID AS student_ID,
  student.tot_cred AS student_tot_cred,
  advisor.i_ID AS i_ID
FROM advisor
JOIN student ON student.ID = advisor.s_ID
views.description: One row per student-advisor assignment, exposing student and advisor IDs and student academic attributes; useful to filter students by advisor properties.

views.name: instructors_teaching_sections
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  t.ID AS instructor_ID,
  t.course_id,
  t.sec_id,
  t.semester,
  t.year,
  i.salary AS instructor_salary,
  s.building,
  s.room_number,
  s.time_slot_id
FROM teaches t
JOIN instructor i ON i.ID = t.ID
LEFT JOIN section_room_mapping s ON
  s.course_id = t.course_id AND
  s.sec_id = t.sec_id AND
  s.semester = t.semester AND
  s.year = t.year
views.description: Rows linking instructors to the sections they teach (denormalized teaches -> section -> optional time/room); exposes instructor ID, section identity (course, sec, semester, year) and instructor salary for filtering by instructor attributes and section attributes like semester.

views.name: students_eligible_cohort
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  student.ID AS student_ID,
  student.tot_cred AS student_tot_cred
FROM student
WHERE student.tot_cred >= 0
views.description: Cohort-like view of students meeting common academic filters (exposes student ID and tot_cred). Designed to be a reusable row-level filter for counting or further joins.

views.name: department_basic_39
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  dept_name,
  building,
  budget
FROM
  department
WHERE
  budget IS NOT NULL
views.description: One row per department with its identifying attributes and normalized numeric budget; filters out departments with NULL budget when budget is required.

views.name: course_by_department
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  course.course_id AS course_id,
  course.dept_name AS dept_name,
  course.credits AS credits,
  course.title AS title
FROM course
views.description: One row per course exposing department, credits and course identifier to allow cohorting departments by course attributes (e.g., existence of courses with credits > N).

views.name: department_course_presence
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  d.dept_name AS dept_name,
  COUNT(c.course_id) AS qualifying_course_count
FROM
  department d
LEFT JOIN
  course c
ON
  c.dept_name = d.dept_name
WHERE
  d.dept_name IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY
  d.dept_name
views.description: Aggregated indicator per department showing whether the department offers any course meeting specified credit criteria and the count of such courses; keeps raw counts so different thresholds can be applied later.

views.name: courses_with_credits_and_department
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  course.course_id AS course_id,
  course.title AS title,
  course.dept_name AS dept_name,
  course.credits AS credits
FROM course
views.description: One row per course exposing its identifier, title, department and credit value. Useful to filter courses by credit thresholds and to join to department-level data.

views.name: departments_basic
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  dept_name,
  building,
  budget
FROM department
views.description: One row per department exposing department name, building and budget. Useful for counting or filtering departments and for joining to course lists.

views.name: department_course_counts_by_credit_bucket
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  department.dept_name AS dept_name,
  course.credits AS credits,
  COUNT(course.course_id) AS course_count
FROM
  department
  JOIN course ON course.dept_name = department.dept_name
GROUP BY
  department.dept_name,
  course.credits
views.description: Aggregated counts of courses per department broken out by credit value (raw credit). Useful to quickly find departments that have any courses above/below certain credit thresholds.

views.name: courses_core
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  course.course_id AS course_id,
  course.title AS title,
  course.dept_name AS dept_name,
  course.credits AS credits
FROM course
views.description: One row per course with its identifying and dimensional attributes (department, title, credits). Useful as the canonical course cohort for counts, filters, and joins to department or other course-level analyses.

views.name: department_basic_46
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  department.dept_name AS dept_name,
  department.building AS building,
  department.budget AS budget
FROM department
views.description: One row per department with its key attributes (name, building, budget). Useful to validate department existence, join to courses, or filter by department attributes.

views.name: courses_with_department
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  course.course_id AS course_id,
  course.title AS title,
  course.dept_name AS dept_name,
  course.credits AS credits,
  department_core.building AS department_building,
  department_core.budget AS department_budget
FROM course
LEFT JOIN department_core ON course.dept_name = department_core.dept_name
grain: course.course_id  -- one row per course (augmented with department attributes)
views.description: Denormalized view joining courses to their department info so queries can filter or aggregate courses by department fields without extra joins.

views.name: course_prerequisite_links
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  course_id,
  prereq_id
FROM
  prereq
views.description: One row per recorded prerequisite relationship linking a course to one of its prerequisite courses.

views.name: course_basic
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  course.course_id AS course_id,
  course.title AS title,
  course.dept_name AS dept_name,
  course.credits AS credits
FROM course
views.description: Canonical course catalog entries with primary identifiers and title, plus department and credits for filtering/grouping.

views.name: course_prereq_counts
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  c.course_id AS course_id,
  COUNT(DISTINCT p.prereq_id) AS distinct_prereq_count
FROM
  course c
LEFT JOIN
  prereq p
ON
  c.course_id = p.course_id
GROUP BY
  c.course_id
views.description: Per-course counts of distinct prerequisite course IDs (one row per course with the distinct prereq count).

views.name: department_by_building
views.body_sql:
SELECT dept_name, building
FROM department
WHERE building IS NOT NULL AND building != ''
views.description: One row per department including its building and department name; filters out null/empty building values when canonicalizing building.

views.name: building_department_counts
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  building,
  COUNT(DISTINCT dept_name) AS distinct_dept_count
FROM department
WHERE building IS NOT NULL
  AND building != ''
GROUP BY building
views.description: Aggregated counts of distinct departments per building. Produces one row per building with the distinct department count (useful for filtering buildings by how many departments they house).

views.name: classroom_building_capacity
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  building,
  room_number,
  capacity
FROM classroom
WHERE building IS NOT NULL AND building != ''
views.description: Rooms (classrooms) annotated with their building and capacity. Useful for queries that join building-level department information with classroom capacities or room counts.

views.name: course_basic_54
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  course.course_id AS course_id,
  course.title AS title,
  course.credits AS credits,
  course.dept_name AS dept_name
FROM course
views.description: One row per course with canonicalized key and cleaned important attributes (title, credits, department). Filters out courses with NULL or empty dept_name or NULL credits when used by question_ops, but leaves raw data here for reuse.

views.name: prereq_edges
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  prereq.course_id AS course_id,
  prereq.prereq_id AS prereq_id
FROM prereq
views.description: Row-level prerequisite relationships: one row per (course_id, prereq_id) edge. Suitable for counting distinct prerequisites per course and for graph/hierarchy queries.

views.name: course_with_prereq_counts
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  prereq.course_id AS course_id,
  COUNT(DISTINCT prereq.prereq_id) AS distinct_prereq_count
FROM
  prereq
GROUP BY
  prereq.course_id
views.description: Aggregate counts of distinct prerequisites per course. Exposes course_id and the distinct prerequisite count to support filters like 'more than one prerequisite'.

views.name: course_base
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  course.course_id AS course_id,
  course.title AS title,
  course.credits AS credits,
  course.dept_name AS dept_name
FROM course
views.description: Canonical projection of course attributes: one row per course with its identifying and descriptive fields useful for joins, filtering, and reporting.

views.name: prereq_links
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  prereq.course_id AS course_id,
  prereq.prereq_id AS prereq_id
FROM prereq
grain: prereq.course_id, prereq.prereq_id (one row per prerequisite link)
views.description: Each prerequisite relationship as one row: maps a course to a single prerequisite course id. Useful for counting distinct prerequisites or traversing prerequisite graphs.

views.name: course_prereq_counts_59
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.course_id AS course_id,
  COUNT(DISTINCT p.prereq_id) AS distinct_prereq_count
FROM prereq p
GROUP BY p.course_id
views.description: Aggregated counts of distinct prerequisites per course. Exposes counts so callers can filter courses by how many distinct prereqs they have.

views.name: department_core_60
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  department.dept_name AS dept_name,
  CASE
    WHEN department.budget IS NULL THEN NULL
    ELSE CAST(department.budget AS numeric)
  END AS budget
FROM department
views.description: One row per department exposing its identifier and budget as a numeric measure; canonicalizes/normalizes budget and department name for downstream aggregation and joins.

views.name: department_budget_aggregates_by_dept
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  dept_name,
  COUNT(dept_name) AS budget_count,
  SUM(budget) AS budget_sum,
  AVG(budget) AS budget_avg
FROM department
GROUP BY dept_name
views.description: Per-department aggregated budget measures (e.g., mean, sum, count) computed from department rows. Keeps dept_name as the grouping key so callers can select avg_budget or other aggregates as needed.

views.name: courses_without_prereqs
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  c.course_id,
  c.title,
  c.dept_name,
  c.credits
FROM course AS c
LEFT JOIN prereq AS p
  ON c.course_id = p.course_id
WHERE p.course_id IS NULL
views.description: All courses that do not appear as a course_id in the prereq table (i.e., courses with no prerequisites).

views.name: section_classroom_usage
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  srm.course_id,
  srm.sec_id,
  srm.semester,
  srm.year,
  srm.building,
  srm.room_number,
  srm.time_slot_id,
  cr.capacity
FROM section_room_mapping AS srm
LEFT JOIN classroom_core AS cr
  ON srm.building = cr.building
  AND srm.room_number = cr.room_number
grain: one row per section (section identified by course_id, sec_id, semester, year)
views.description: Mapping of sections to the classroom they use (denormalized), exposing section identifying keys along with referenced classroom capacity and building/room identifiers.

views.name: department_course_section_classrooms
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  d.dept_name AS dept_name,
  c.course_id AS course_id,
  (s.course_id || '|' || s.sec_id || '|' || s.semester || '|' || s.year) AS section_key,
  s.building AS building,
  s.room_number AS room_number,
  cr.capacity AS capacity
FROM department d
JOIN course c ON c.dept_name = d.dept_name
JOIN section s ON s.course_id = c.course_id
LEFT JOIN classroom cr ON cr.building = s.building AND cr.room_number = s.room_number
grain: one row per (department, course, section, classroom) usage
views.description: Denormalized relation linking department -> course -> section -> classroom capacity. Useful to compute department-level aggregates of classrooms used by that department's courses.

views.name: course_basic_65
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  course.course_id AS course_id,
  course.title AS title,
  course.dept_name AS dept_name,
  course.credits AS credits
FROM course
views.description: One row per course with canonical course identifiers and key attributes useful for filtering, grouping, and joining to department or prereq. Exposes title, department, credits and the course primary key.

views.name: prereq_edge
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  course_id,
  prereq_id
FROM
  prereq
grain: prereq.course_id, prereq.prereq_id (one row per prerequisite edge)
views.description: Cohort of prerequisite relationships as edges (course -> prereq). One row per prereq relation; useful to identify courses that appear as targets (have prerequisites) or to build transitive prerequisite graphs.

views.name: department_course_counts
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  d.dept_name AS dept_name,
  COUNT(c.course_id) AS dept_course_count
FROM
  department d
LEFT JOIN
  course c
ON
  d.dept_name = c.dept_name
GROUP BY
  d.dept_name
views.description: Count of courses per department. One row per department with the raw course_count measure; useful for reporting or joining back to courses to show department-level totals.

views.name: course_core
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  course_id,
  title,
  dept_name,
  credits
FROM course
views.description: Canonical projection of the course table exposing stable course identifiers and descriptive attributes for filtering, joining and grouping.

views.name: course_prereq_map
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  prereq.course_id AS course_id,
  prereq.prereq_id AS prereq_id
FROM prereq
grain: prereq.course_id, prereq.prereq_id  -- one row per prerequisite relationship
views.description: Denormalized mapping of courses to their prerequisites. One row per (course, prereq) relationship; useful to identify which courses have prerequisites and to build prerequisite graphs.

views.name: course_with_prereq_flag
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  c.course_id,
  CASE WHEN pr.prereq_count IS NULL OR pr.prereq_count = 0 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS has_prereq,
  COALESCE(pr.prereq_count, 0) AS prereq_count
FROM
  course AS c
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT
    course_id,
    COUNT(prereq_id) AS prereq_count
  FROM
    prereq
  GROUP BY
    course_id
) AS pr
  ON c.course_id = pr.course_id
views.description: One-row-per-course marker indicating whether a course has any prerequisites (boolean) and the count of prerequisites. Useful for filters, aggregations and quick existence checks.

views.name: teaches_section_link
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  t.ID,
  t.course_id,
  t.sec_id,
  t.semester,
  t.year,
  s.building,
  s.room_number,
  s.time_slot_id
FROM teaches AS t
LEFT JOIN section_room_mapping AS s
  ON t.course_id = s.course_id
  AND t.sec_id = s.sec_id
  AND t.semester = s.semester
  AND t.year = s.year
views.description: Denormalized teaches rows joined to their corresponding section rows so each teaching assignment is accompanied by section semester, year, and location columns. Useful for filtering instructors by semester/year and for queries that need section metadata alongside teaches.

views.name: instructor_teaching_events
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  teaches.ID AS ID,
  teaches.course_id AS course_id,
  teaches.sec_id AS sec_id,
  teaches.semester AS semester,
  teaches.year AS year
FROM teaches
views.description: Canonical teaching-event cohort projecting the instructor ID and the canonical section identifiers (course, sec, semester, year). Exposes the minimal columns needed to count or group instructors by term or course.

views.name: instructor_identity
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  instructor.ID AS ID,
  instructor.name AS name,
  instructor.dept_name AS dept_name,
  instructor.salary AS salary
FROM instructor
views.description: Normalized instructor identity and department metadata. Useful to attach instructor attributes (name, dept, salary) when reporting counts or grouping by department.
